mathematical_invariants_extracted.factor_crowding_mechanics: Simultaneous liquidation: Longs drop, Shorts rally, dollar-neutral books collapse
mathematical_invariants_extracted.the_25_sigma_fallacy: Models assumed independent exogenous returns; reality was endogenous fire-sales
mathematical_invariants_extracted.brunnermeier_pedersen_spiral: Margin m_t = f(sigma_t) -> higher volatility forces liquidation -> spreads widen -> higher margin
mathematical_invariants_extracted.epiphany_equation_crowding: Theta_Quant = [1/K sum (AUM_k / ADV_k)] * rho_Factor * L_bar * (d_Margin / d_sigma) * exp(Illiquidity_Credit / Liquidity_Equity)
